title: 街路EV充電ポスト
description: 表示部、カード読取部、ホルスター内コネクターとたるんだケーブルを備えた汎用充電ポスト。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Generic street EV post with display, reader, holstered connector, draped solid cable and service access. Visual prop; not an electrical specification or certified charger. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
